conditions.scope: Physical dedicated server with installed Server Login; only vanilla ServerboundClientCommandPacket.Action.PERFORM_RESPAWN

change.summary: Dead players can use the vanilla respawn button before login, without unlocking their account or permitting other gameplay packets.

modifiers.before: Server Login1.0.3 PacketPolicy denies all ServerboundClientCommandPacket actions before authentication; a player saved with Health0 cannot respawn to reach the login UI.
modifiers.after: Dedicated-only JEM Compat adapter admits only PERFORM_RESPAWN. Vanilla validates the current player and binds the respawned replacement; all other packets/actions and authentication ownership remain upstream.

cause.owner: Mods/JEMCompat optional dedicated-only Server Login adapter

rationale.purpose: Break the dead-before-login cycle at the packet classifier that caused it, without authenticating or healing the old entity as a fallback.
rationale.decision_source: User reported being unable to respawn again; narrow native packet adaptation and server-only delivery selected by Codex from exact installed bytecode and live locked/dead state.

introduced.summary: Allow native PERFORM_RESPAWN through Server Login pre-auth packet policy on a physical dedicated server; authentication remains locked and native lifecycle owns all validation and replacement binding.

history.summary: Allow native PERFORM_RESPAWN through Server Login pre-auth packet policy on a physical dedicated server; authentication remains locked and native lifecycle owns all validation and replacement binding.

systems: Vanilla dead-player respawn and connection binding
Native death penalties and event elimination
relations: Locked dead connection -> native respawn -> living but still locked connection -> ordinary password authentication
notes: Live authorized recovery used the complete vanilla client-command handler; health became24.499998 and both before/after authentication stayed locked.

No automatic event resurrection, hidden life, account unlock, new registry, custom packet, client prediction or client resource change. Existing clients use the same vanilla packet; canonical ManagedPack/publication32 remain unchanged.
unresolved: Player acceptance of future pre-auth respawn button flow remains pending.
